main_text.p: sint alterius, ut Aben Esra placet. Alii à כְּלָא[?], quòd omnia includat; Alii à כְּלָה Consumi, quòd perpetuo habendi desiderio seipsum consumit & conficit.
כִּים f. Vergiliæ, Plejades, Job.9.9. עֲשֵׂה כִּימָה Faciens Plejadas, Amos 5.8.

כִּים m. Loculus, Marsupium, Crumena: כִּים אֶחָד יִהְיֶה לְכֻלָּנוּ Crumena una erit omnibus nobis, Proverb.1.14. Aff. בְּכִיסְךָ In loculo tuo, Deut.25.13. Aben Esra deducit à כָּסַס Numerare, supputare, quòd inde semper depromantur numeranda & exsolvenda. Rabbinorum communis sententia est; בְּכִים בְּכוֹס בְּכַעַס In loculo, in poculo & in oculo irato, cognoscitur hominis ingenium.
כִּיפָא Petra; In Targum respondet Hebræo סֶלַע: Plural. כִּיפִים Et petrarum, Job.30.6. וּבְכִפִּים Et in petras, Jerem.4.29. Hinc Apostolus Petrus Kephas dictus.

כִּיּוֹר m. Labrum, Lavacrum, Concha, Vasis genus, Exod.30.18. 1.Sam.2.14. Focus, Foculus, vas ad fovendum ignem, Zach.12.6. Suggestus, 2.Par.6.13. Plural. כִּיּוֹרִים Labra, 2.Par.4.6. Et fœm. אֶת־הַכִּיּוֹרוֹת Labra, 1.Reg.7.40.
כִּירִים m. d. Testus, vas fictile, in quo placenta, liba & id genus similia, coquebantur, Levit.11.35. Ejus nunquam usus, nisi cum operculo, unde quasi duplum censebatur, cui servit forma dualis.
כְּ Sic, apud Rabbinos frequentissimum: Inde, כָּכָה Sic, Ita, Numer.11.15. שֶׁכָּכָה Quòd sic, Cant.5.9. שֶׁכָּכָה לּוֹ Cui ita est, Psal.144.15.

כּוֹכָב masc. Stella: דֶּרֶךְ כּוֹכָב Procedet stella, Num.24.17. Constr. כּוֹכַב Hamos 5.26. Plur. כּוֹכָבִים Stellæ, Gen.37.9. Constr. כּוֹכְבֵי Jesa.13.10. Aff. כּוֹכְבֵיהֶם Stellas eorum, Ezech.32.7[?].

page.notes: Headword forms in Hebrew, including כְּלָא and כְּלָה, are read from a small scan and may carry vowel points I could not confirm (marked [?] where doubtful). "Ezech.32.7" is printed with an unclear final figure. The page carries no marginal notes.
